seoTitle: Which Naruto Character Are You? Naruto Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Naruto test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Naruto, Sasuke, Sakura, Kakashi, Hinata, Shikamaru, Itachi or Gaara — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the loud underdog who never gives up, the lone genius who keeps everyone at a distance, or the strategist who thinks everything is a drag? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle friends, rivals and loss, and find out which Naruto character you are.

characters.name: Naruto Uzumaki
characters.title: The Never-Give-Up Underdog
characters.summary: Loud, stubborn and impossible to stop. Everyone doubted you — and you're going to prove every single one of them wrong.
description: Like Naruto, you're an underdog. He grew up alone and ignored, and he decided he'd become Hokage so everyone would have to acknowledge him.
You never go back on your word. That's your ninja way.
You're loud and a bit reckless, but your belief in people changes them — even your enemies.
characters.signature: An orange jumpsuit, a bowl of Ichiraku ramen and "Believe it!"
characters.clashReason: they'd never give up — even when you want them to

characters.name: Sasuke Uchiha
characters.title: The Lone Avenger
characters.summary: Cool, brilliant and driven by something dark. You walk your own path — even if it leads you away from everyone.
description: Like Sasuke, you're gifted. He's a prodigy from the legendary Uchiha clan.
You're driven. After losing his family, Sasuke devoted his life to revenge.
You keep people at a distance, but the bonds you pretend not to care about matter more than you admit.
characters.flaw: Revenge and pride push away the people who care about you.
characters.signature: The Sharingan and a cold stare.
characters.clashReason: they'd shut you out and go it alone

characters.name: Sakura Haruno
characters.title: The Late-Blooming Powerhouse
characters.summary: Smart, determined and terrifyingly strong when you need to be. You worked for everything you have.
description: Like Sakura, you started behind. She was the one who felt weakest on her team.
So you worked. Sakura trained under Tsunade and became a brilliant medical ninja with a punch that can split the ground.
You're smart, caring and fiercely loyal to your friends.
characters.flaw: Your temper is short, and you're hard on yourself.
characters.signature: Pink hair, healing hands and a punch nobody wants to take.

characters.name: Kakashi Hatake
characters.title: The Laid-Back Genius
characters.summary: Cool, relaxed and secretly brilliant. You're always late — but you always show up when it matters.
description: Like Kakashi, you're laid-back. He's always late, always reading his favourite book and never seems stressed.
But you're a genius. Kakashi is one of the most talented ninja in the world.
You've lost a lot, and you carry it quietly — which is why you protect your students so fiercely.
characters.flaw: You're late. Always. And you hide your feelings.
characters.signature: A face mask, a book he definitely shouldn't read in public and an excuse for being late.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn up late and act like it's fine

characters.name: Hinata Hyuga
characters.title: The Quiet Strength
characters.summary: Gentle, shy and braver than anyone expects. You speak softly — but when you stand up, the world notices.
description: Like Hinata, you're quiet. She's shy and gentle, and she struggled with confidence for years.
But you never give up. Hinata kept trying, inspired by Naruto's refusal to quit.
When it counts, you're incredibly brave. Hinata stood up to one of the strongest enemies in the world to protect the person she loves.
characters.flaw: You doubt yourself far too much.
characters.signature: Pale eyes, a gentle smile and a very red face around Naruto.
characters.clashReason: they'd be too quiet to tell you what they really think

characters.name: Shikamaru Nara
characters.title: The Lazy Genius
characters.summary: Brilliant, lazy and always three moves ahead. You'd rather watch the clouds — but you'll outthink anyone when you have to.
description: Like Shikamaru, you're a genius who doesn't want to try. Everything is "such a drag."
But you're a master strategist. Shikamaru can win almost any fight or game of shogi by thinking several moves ahead.
You're loyal and dependable, and you step up when your friends need you.
characters.flaw: You're lazy and avoid effort until you have no choice.
characters.signature: A shogi board, a spiky ponytail and "What a drag."
characters.clashReason: they'd call everything you care about 'too much effort'

characters.name: Itachi Uchiha
characters.title: The Misunderstood Sacrifice
characters.summary: Calm, brilliant and carrying a secret nobody knows. You'll let the world hate you if it protects the people you love.
description: Like Itachi, you're a prodigy — one of the most gifted ninja ever.
You make impossible sacrifices. Itachi bore terrible things alone to protect his village and his little brother.
People think they know you. They don't — and you'd rather they didn't.
characters.flaw: You carry everything alone and let people misunderstand you.
characters.signature: A cloak with red clouds and a quiet, sad smile.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep you in the dark for your own good

characters.name: Gaara
characters.title: The Changed Outcast
characters.summary: Quiet, intense and transformed by kindness. You know what loneliness feels like — and you'd never let anyone feel that way again.
description: Like Gaara, you've been an outsider. He grew up feared and alone because of the monster sealed inside him.
You were changed by one person who understood you. For Gaara, meeting Naruto changed everything.
You became a leader. Gaara rose to become Kazekage and protect the village that once feared him.
characters.flaw: Old wounds still make it hard to connect.
characters.signature: A gourd full of sand and a symbol for 'love' on his forehead.
characters.clashReason: they'd be very hard to get close to

questions.text: It's your first day with a new team. You...

options.text: Tell everyone you're going to be the best one here
Say as little as possible. You're here for your own reasons
Arrive late, relaxed, with a very flimsy excuse
Hope nobody notices how nervous you are

questions.text: It's a lazy day with nothing planned. You...

options.text: Lie on the grass and watch the clouds
Eat far too much of your favourite food
Reread your favourite book. Again
Train. Alone

questions.text: A close friend walks away from everyone and cuts you off. You...

options.text: Chase them. You'll bring them back, whatever it takes
Get stronger, so next time you can actually help
Understand. You know what it's like to feel completely alone
Make a plan to get them back

questions.text: You're choosing where to eat. You pick...

options.text: Your usual spot. You've eaten there a thousand times
A sweet café. Dessert first
Wherever everyone else wants. You're just happy to be invited
Whatever's closest. Walking is effort

questions.text: Someone you love is in danger, and you're completely out of your league. You...

options.text: Step in front of them anyway
Protect them with everything you've got
Stay calm and quietly take the hit for them
Run for help. Charging in alone just means two people in trouble

questions.text: You're up against a really tough challenge. You...

options.text: Outthink it
Refuse to stay down
Deal with it quickly and quietly, before it gets worse
Use every skill you have. Show no weakness

questions.text: Your team's in trouble with the people in charge. You...

options.text: Take the blame quietly. Let them think the worst of you
Stand up and argue. Loudly
Stay calm. Nobody needs to panic
Work out the smartest way to make it all go away
Ask if someone else can do it. What a drag
Lead calmly, and protect your team above everything
Take it very seriously. You'll never let them down
Push everyone to be their best

questions.text: A friend gets hurt doing something reckless. You...

options.text: Stay by their side and quietly cheer them on
Patch them up — and tell them off for it
Give them calm advice they'll remember for years
Sit with them so they're not alone

questions.text: Your own family is planning something that could destroy your whole town. Stopping them means losing them forever. You...

options.text: Stop them — even if you have to carry it alone for the rest of your life
Find a way to stop them without losing anyone. There's always a way
Stand up to them, even though you're terrified
Walk away from all of it

questions.text: The person who ruined your life offers to teach you everything you need to get stronger. You...

options.text: Accept. Power is power
Refuse. You're done letting the past control you
Say yes — and secretly work against them from the inside
Turn it down, and tell someone you trust immediately

questions.text: Imagine you lost someone important years ago. Today, you...

options.text: Visit the place they're remembered, every single day
Carry their dream forward for them
Still haven't talked about it. To anyone
Protect everyone else, so nobody else feels that pain
